triples.tail_surface: lube oil samples can be taken for the purpose of detecting particle contamination and possible signs of bearing failure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 润滑油取样检测颗粒污染及轴承故障迹象
triples.evidence_text: Arrangements are to be provided so that lube oil samples can be taken for the purpose of detecting particle contamination and possible signs of bearing failure.

triples.tail_surface: serviced without interrupting the pod operation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在不中断吊舱运行的情况下进行维护
triples.evidence_text: Lube oil filters are to be of magnetic type and so arranged that they can be serviced without interrupting the pod operation.

triples.head_surface: entry of water into the machine
triples.tail_surface: cooler is to be so arranged to avoid entry of water into the machine, whether through leakage or condensation in the heat exchanger
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 冷却器布置应避免水通过泄漏或热交换器冷凝进入机器
triples.evidence_text: Where water cooling is used, the cooler is to be so arranged to avoid entry of water into the machine, whether through leakage or condensation in the heat exchanger.

triples.tail_surface: lock each pod unit’s slewing mechanism in its center (neutral) position
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将每个吊舱单元的旋转机构锁定在中心（中立）位置
triples.evidence_text: means are to be provided to lock each pod unit’s slewing mechanism in its center (neutral) position in the event of a steering system failure.
